description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object for custom field search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for screen and field number filters, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: CustomFieldSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for custom field search filtering, including screen and field number filters

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with a default sort field

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the current screen filter value

methods.name: getFieldNumbers
methods.description: Returns the current array of field numbers for filtering

methods.name: setFieldNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of field numbers for filtering
